title: Dataset of electrophysiological signals (EEG, ECG, EMG) during Music therapy with adult burn patients in the Intensive Care Unit.
description: This dataset contains electrophysiological recordings (EEG, ECG, and facial EMG) from nine adult burn patients in an intensive care unit who received music therapy. It is part of a single-site randomized clinical trial. Each patient was recorded during two Music-Assisted Relaxation sessions, each with pre-intervention, intervention, and post-intervention phases. Pain (VAS) and anxiety-depression (HADS) measures were also collected to relate to the physiological signals.
methods_description: Recordings used a Micromed LTM64 clinical system at a sampling rate of at least 256 Hz. EEG was recorded from eight 10-20 sites (FP1, FP2, T3, T4, C3, C4, O1, O2) with a Cz reference. ECG was recorded with a bipolar lead II montage. Corrugator supercilii EMG was recorded with bipolar electrodes on the left eyebrow. Each patient completed two Music-Assisted Relaxation sessions on different days, and pain (VAS) and anxiety/depression (HADS) were assessed.
